meaning.use_for: Understand actions, relationships, object roles, and which aspects of the source a request concerns.
meaning.scope: Semantic interpretation guidance; it does not guarantee preservation by a renderer.

design-expression.use_for: Connect a visual idea to concrete materials, regions, and relationships in a proposal.
design-expression.scope: Design guidance and authored examples; example wording is not a validated recipe.

experience-map.use_for: Find advice about editing inputs, expressing changes, inspecting results, and using design knowledge.
experience-map.scope: Common-sense starting guidance with separately attributed experimental observations.

theme.use_for: Explore why a visual language suits a subject or activity.

media.use_for: Compare how line, pigment, paper, light, and other media form an image.

time.use_for: Explore composition, lighting, camera, and changes over time.

combination.use_for: Understand relationships that can connect several design directions.

experience.use_for: Inspect conditions behind historical generation and planning outcomes.
experience.scope: Historical systems and configurations; consult original records for applicability.

choose-editing-input.use_for: Consider an original input, an earlier candidate, or continued editing for the current change.
choose-editing-input.scope: Initial common-sense route preferences; no controlled route advantage has been established.

express-edits.use_for: Describe a change in relation to the video the renderer will actually receive.
express-edits.scope: Initial expression guidance; text does not guarantee local editing or preservation.

inspect-and-compare.use_for: Inspect consequential uncertainties and compare candidate tradeoffs.
inspect-and-compare.scope: Initial inspection guidance with historical review limitations.

use-design-knowledge.use_for: Find and adapt design relationships that help answer the current question.
use-design-knowledge.scope: Reading and adaptation guidance; no reading quota or measured retrieval advantage.

bernini-r-20261029.use_for: Inspect the October 29 style-prompt probe and its observed successes and failures.
bernini-r-20261029.scope: Bernini-R only: four source clips, ten single-generation conditions, seed 42, 40 steps. Transfer to Ditto and multi-round input choice is unverified.
